question: Do getrusage/times/rlimit leak host values, and if virtualized do they stay continuous (#140)?
answer: No leak -- deterministic on all three backends. But ru_utime/ru_stime and the fault/context-switch counters are ZEROED (#140 anti-pattern), while /proc/uptime advances 123->130 in the same run.
kvm: NOT tested -- livelocks at guest startup
inconsistent: times() return is frozen in-run and backend-dependent
not_done: did not locate where the zeroing is implemented
